- **Trump signs AI executive order**: A voluntary framework for pre-release review of frontier models, reported by [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/policy/941775/trump-ai-executive-order) and [Google News AI](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxNREtSUDhhcVBDX3hpa3ZKbDg4VzRrMzNVSk1XaTNCcjltVUpFaDZZN0EtTFZFSjI3SXJGVEVGREJDb3Jtb184aThoMXVFNEtGSHZyWXFfUmRrZ0tDWnVqZmFab0VIVzVJVWFndkQ1UHo2TFdjcUNqUFB3cGVUakZZTjJRYWpFTGlfNjVIVU5RSVVLd3AxSGpUM3c5OWpEWW8).
- **Google deepfake call detection**: Android's June feature drop adds detection of spoofed calls and AI impersonation, per [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/02/google-rolls-out-fake-call-detection-to-protect-against-ai-deepfake-impersonation-scams/) and [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/06/google-announces-deepfake-call-detection-for-android-new-airdrop-device-support/).
- **Uber caps employee AI spending**: After burning through its annual budget in 4 months, Uber implemented caps, as reported by [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/02/uber-caps-employee-ai-spending-after-blowing-through-budget-in-four-months/).
- **AI outperforms law professors**: A Stanford Law study found AI models surpassing human professors, sparking discussion on [Hacker News](https://law.stanford.edu/press/ai-outperforms-law-professors-in-stanford-law-study/).

The tension between innovation and regulation is palpable; watch whether Trump's 'voluntary' framework becomes de facto mandatory, and how Microsoft's in-house models stack against OpenAI's.

HackNews社区动态.zh:
开发者社区今日热度集中于底层工具与语言体验。Nvidia GPU显存作为Linux交换空间的项目获230赞，解决了大模型训练时的显存闲置问题。Clojure使用心得（186赞）反映了Lisp系语言在函数式编程爱好者中的持续吸引力。Agentic Mfw网站以讽刺方式调侃AI Agent炒作，而Roku LT OS开源则给嵌入式开发带来新选择。

- [用Nvidia显存作Linux交换空间](https://github.com/c0dejedi/nbd-vram) —— 创意工具，缓解VRAM压力，获230分。
- [使用Clojure一个月后的感受](https://www.acdw.net/clojure/) —— 个人经验分享，引发186条评论深度讨论。
- [Agentic Mfw](https://agenticmotherfucking.website/) —— 反讽当前AI Agent热潮，132分。
- [Roku LT操作系统开源发布](https://blog.roku.com/developer/roku-lt-os) —— 电视盒系统开放，或推动家居硬件开发。
- [Pluto.jl 1.0发布：Julia交互式笔记本](https://discourse.julialang.org/t/pluto-1-0-release/137296) —— 数据科学工具迭代，获74分。

**收束**：社区对实用工具和反讽内容同样热衷，底层创新与语言选择仍是开发者关注的核心。
HackNews社区动态.en:
The Hacker News community rallied around a mix of satire, practical tools, and academic curiosities. A satirical 'Agentic Mfw' site drew 132 points, while more serious projects like Pluto.jl 1.0 and a tool to use Nvidia VRAM as swap garnered significant engagement. Show HN showcased Paseo, an open-source coding agent interface, and a study on ancient Mohenjo-daro social equality sparked discussion.

- **[Agentic Mfw](https://agenticmotherfucking.website/)**: A parody site mocking agentic AI hype, with 132 points and 38 comments.
- **[Pluto.jl 1.0 released](https://discourse.julialang.org/t/pluto-1-0-release/137296)**: The reactive notebook for Julia reaches a major milestone (74 points).
- **[Use Nvidia VRAM as swap on Linux](https://github.com/c0dejedi/nbd-vram)**: A practical tool (230 points, 65 comments) for leveraging GPU memory as system swap.
- **[Show HN: Paseo](https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo)**: A beautiful open-source coding agent interface (55 points, 27 comments).
- **[Mohenjo-daro grew more equal over time](https://archaeologymag.com/2026/05/mohenjo-daro-grew-more-equal-over-time/)**: An archaeological study (76 points, 36 comments) suggesting increasing equality in the ancient city.

The community's dual focus on practical tooling (VRAM swap, Paseo) and reflective content (satire, history) suggests a healthy balance of utility and critique. Keep an eye on whether Paseo gains traction as a coding agent alternative.

足球.zh: 转会市场重磅不断：曼联以3500万镑签下亚特兰大26岁中场埃德森（[Sources: Man United agree deal to sign Ederson](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48953983/man-united-agree-deal-atalanta-ederson-sources)），这将是卡里克执教后的首笔引援，曼联中场硬度和创造力有望提升。利物浦也敲定伯恩茅斯主帅伊劳拉（[Sources: Liverpool reach deal to appoint Iraola](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48951109/liverpool-agreement-andoni-iraola-new-head-coach)），开启后克洛普时代的新篇章。皇马则在追逐法国后卫科纳特（[Source: Konaté closing on move to Real Madrid](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48949796/ibrahima-konate-closing-move-real-madrid)），后防线年轻化加速。另外，富勒姆宣布马尔科·席尔瓦离任（[Fulham confirm Silva to leave club this summer](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48948294/fulham-confirm-marco-silva-leave-club-manager-summer)），他五年的执教为球队带来稳定，但今夏需另寻新帅。世界杯前线也出现波折：瑞士前锋恩博洛因旅行文件被审查延迟赴美（[U.S. delays WCup entry for Swiss striker Embolo](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48946383/us-delays-entry-switzerland-breel-embolo-world-cup-travel-documents)），伊朗队则在等待美墨签证（[Source: Iran expects U.S., Mexico visas this week](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48949687/iran-expects-us-mexico-visas-arrive-week)），政治因素正影响赛事筹备。整体看，欧洲豪门换血与世界杯物流问题并列成为今日焦点，后续需关注各队引援进度及伊朗、瑞士等队的入境许可进展。
足球.en:
The football world is buzzing with early summer transfer activity and World Cup off-field narratives. Manchester United have secured Brazilian midfielder Éderson from Atalanta for £35m, while Liverpool have appointed Bournemouth's Andoni Iraola as head coach replacing Jürgen Klopp. Ibrahima Konaté is on the verge of joining Real Madrid, and Fulham confirmed Marco Silva will leave. Meanwhile, World Cup preparations are fraught with visa delays, health scares, and legal disputes.

- **Man United's first Carrick signing**: Atalanta's Éderson set for Old Trafford after £35m fee agreed ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c78q2dxv89go), [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48953983/man-united-agree-deal-atalanta-ederson-sources)).
- **Liverpool appoint Iraola**: Agreement reached with Andoni Iraola as new head coach, sources confirm ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48951109/liverpool-agreement-andoni-iraola-new-head-coach)).
- **Konaté to Real Madrid**: Negotiations advanced, full agreement nearing ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48949796/ibrahima-konate-closing-move-real-madrid)).
- **World Cup entry troubles**: Iran expects visas this week, but Swiss striker Embolo delayed; Congo's friendly cancelled over Ebola ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48949687/iran-expects-us-mexico-visas-arrive-week), [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48946383/us-delays-entry-switzerland-breel-embolo-world-cup-travel-documents), [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48950773/spanish-mayor-congo-dr-world-cup-chile-ebola)).
- **Other sports on the football desk**: Marta Kostyuk's Ukraine-dedicated tennis win ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/sport/tennis/articles/clypkqpe3d2o)) and Heather Knight's England recall in cricket ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/sport/cricket/articles/c9d3z7pvlg1o)).

The transfer window opens soon; expect further movement as top clubs reshape squads.

篮球.zh: NBA总决赛一触即发：尼克斯中锋米切尔·罗宾逊因手指骨折出战成疑（[Knicks mum on Robinson's status for Game 1](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48950555/knicks-mum-status-mitchell-robinson-finger-game-1)），这对尼克斯内线轮换是隐患。对手马刺则依靠新星卡斯尔（Stephon Castle）的防守来限制布伦森（[Brunson prepared for 'great defender' in Castle](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48952063/jalen-brunson-wary-stephon-castle-defensive-prowess)），同时波波维奇虽未在场边，但仍作为幕后资源为球队提供支持（[Pop culture: Spurs lean on legends as Finals near](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48950639/gregg-popovich-welcome-resource-finals-bound-spurs)）。场外，库里与李宁签下10年4亿美元天价球鞋合同（[Steph joins Li-Ning, ending sneaker free agency](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48940127/stephen-curry-signs-chinese-sportswear-company-li-ning)），标志着中国品牌在NBA顶级代言上的重大突破。此外，名人堂教练里克·阿德尔曼去世（[Hall of Fame basketball coach Adelman dies at 79](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48941923/hall-fame-basketball-coach-rick-adelman-dies-79)），其普林斯顿体系影响深远。CBA方面，古德温压哨绝杀广厦（[[流言板]古德温压哨绝杀广厦，成为CBA总决赛历史上首次压哨绝杀](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTFBreHVjdjRxUld3QzV4anhjLXZueWtIbWhKcGszYUY5SkZVak54clNVUjExTFZTdXlXUUVvRXZJX1d4andXUGdHMXQyazdSaFhGZUhFYXRZUmo3alVSOVJNeHZ5QUgxLVpMX3BiN2FwUmRJdEdfQjhr)），创造历史；中国球员杨瀚森在NBA模拟选秀中被预测首轮16顺位（[杨瀚森首轮16顺位_新浪新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFA2b3pKeWp4M1lkbEQzMlc3Rlg4bkR2WC03S096ampqa2tCdVQ0c2JGbXJBVll2UkxpRVZvVTgzeXBaU21ZbWFBWHMtcndGdDVTZngtWG1lYUh6OW5mSlBtb3M3aw)），中国篮球关注度持续升温。总决赛首战结果将直接定义系列赛基调，而库里签李宁则可能改变NBA球鞋市场竞争格局。
篮球.en:
The NBA Finals begin Wednesday with the Knicks vs Spurs, and key storylines include Mitchell Robinson's finger injury, Jalen Brunson's respect for rookie defender Stephon Castle, and Gregg Popovich's continued influence. Off the court, Stephen Curry's blockbuster Li-Ning deal dominates headlines, while the basketball world mourns Hall of Fame coach Rick Adelman. The CBA Finals saw a historic buzzer beater, and Chinese prospect Yang Hanshen was drafted 16th overall.

- **NBA Finals Game 1 preview**: Mitchell Robinson questionable with broken finger; Brunson warns about Castle's defense ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48950555/knicks-mum-status-mitchell-robinson-finger-game-1), [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48952063/jalen-brunson-wary-stephon-castle-defensive-prowess)).
- **Stephen Curry's $400M Li-Ning deal**: 10-year endorsement ends sneaker free agency ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48940127/stephen-curry-signs-chinese-sportswear-company-li-ning)).
- **Rick Adelman passes away**: Hall of Fame coach of 1,000+ NBA wins dies at 79 ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48941923/hall-fame-basketball-coach-rick-adelman-dies-79)).
- **CBA Finals history**: Goodwin's buzzer beater for Shanxi defeats Guangsha ([Hupu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTFBreHVjdjRxUld3QzV4anhjLXZueWtIbWhKcGszYUY5SkZVak54clNVUjExTFZTdXlXUUVvRXZJX1d4andXUGdHMXQyazdSaFhGZUhFYXRZUmo3alVSOVJNeHZ5QUgxLVpMX3BiN2FwUmRJdEdfQjhr)).
- **Mavericks eye new arena**: Preliminary deal for site away from downtown Dallas ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48941658/dallas-mavericks-eyeing-new-arena-site-away-downtown)).

The Finals tip-off will shape league narratives; Curry's Li-Ning deal signals growing Chinese market influence.

虎扑社区动态.zh: 虎扑社区今日热议话题集中在美国篮球与足球转会。美媒分享文班亚马与亚历山大赛场照片（[美媒分享动态： 一张文班亚马和亚历山大的赛场合照](https://news.google.)），NBA总决赛预热气氛浓厚。快船与篮网、猛龙完成三方交易，克里斯·保罗被送至猛龙（[Shams：快船篮网猛龙达成三方交易， 保罗被送至猛龙](https://news.google.)），引发球迷对保罗职业生涯末期的讨论。利物浦球员18岁前英超出场排名中，恩古莫哈距欧文纪录仅差1场（[利物浦球员18岁前英超出场排名：恩古莫哈距榜首欧文仅差1次](https://news.google.)），显示年轻球员的潜力。网球方面，阿纳尔迪4场比赛用时近18小时创纪录（[[流言板]阿纳尔迪4场比赛用时近18小时，创晋级大满贯八强时长纪录](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE0xR2Y5UXZtLXljQ21sLXpvM2gzOXA2NmVQempYZlRpd25HOFl1SDU5aW5Cc3VFc09EZW5sVnVyU2xEMjVoanRyWFdUSHNfdkxCVlRuWGRHcE5QYS00Qy01WUxHZHZ4NEJldGJlUnNYS0dMRFd1ekow)），展现体能极限。此外，博洛尼亚4-3客胜罗马晋级欧联八强（[博洛尼亚4-3客胜罗马晋级欧联八强， 坎比亚吉加时赛绝杀](https://news.google.)），欧战悬念延续。社区活跃度显示，球迷对NBA交易、转会传闻及欧洲足球赛事的关注度最高，娱乐话题（如歌手帮唱）也有一定流量。
虎扑社区动态.en:
Chinese basketball and sports fan communities are active with NBA-related content, European football updates, and a viral singer rumor. Key discussions include a photo of Wembanyama and SGA, a marathon tennis match, and a Shams report on a Chris Paul trade to the Raptors. Liverpool youth rankings and a Bologna-Roma match also sparked engagement.

- **Wembanyama & Alexander photo**: US media shares court photo of two rising stars ([MSN](https://news.google.)).
- **Arnaldi's marathon record**: Italian player needed nearly 18 hours across four matches to reach Grand Slam quarterfinals ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE0xR2Y5UXZtLXljQ21sLXpvM2gzOXA2NmVQempYZlRpd25HOFl1SDU5aW5Cc3VFc09EZW5sVnVyU2xEMjVoanRyWFdUSHNfdkxCVlRuWGRHcE5QYS00Qy01WUxHZHZ4NEJldGJlUnNYS0dMRFd1ekow)).
- **Shams trade rumor**: Chris Paul sent to Raptors in three-team deal involving Clippers and Nets ([MSN](https://news.google.)).
- **Bologna 4-3 win at Roma**: Cambiaghi scores extra-time winner in Europa League round of 16 ([MSN](https://news.google.)).
- **Liverpool youth ranking**: Ngumoha one appearance shy of Owen's record for most Premier League games before age 18 ([MSN](https://news.google.)).

Hupu communities continue to blend global sports with local fandom; the Chris Paul trade rumor is likely to spur further debate.

羽毛球.zh: 印尼羽毛球公开赛今日进入第二个比赛日，国羽多线出战。首日赛况中，陈柏阳/刘毅对阵阿尔菲安/菲克里（0-1落后），王祉怡对阵杨佳敏（6-0领先）均需后续关注（[印尼🇮🇩羽毛球公开赛【第二日】赛程](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5DaU1qRHQ5Yk1pVS1QNWdFa1BQM3NUdzA3cU5jX2hrMkhnd3FnYlpQNUlHc2VrRXNuUHB6OV9RZjJ1czAtT3ppdmFoLVNYVFlVNUdyQVZ0SGNoZXVuZjFIbUw4OA)）。男双组合梁伟铿/王昶排名更新（[梁伟铿/王昶排名更新_新浪新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5JZVdfaFI3MGdUTGdKLVFVTThEVFBmci1hbDNtTzBKbkMxc3N2LXlScDF5WHZPVUN4Vktzcm40ZEhQb3N2N0JRby15VlNoQmY3YWZ4YmxhNzFOUklVNVB3MzdhRQ)），二人近期状态波动，王昶赛后总结经验（[王昶总结经验再战_新浪新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1LRm1TMmU1QWJJSUJIYzhwTmFLQ0lzcTkwcnA1ZFItb1VNTlBBZG9UNHd4NkhJVlhsWnhsRGY0Zk53Yk5VMEh1ZHRoQlBkZHJSdDlFVzN6U29qWVZWUHc0bGpkUQ)），表明国羽男双正为奥运积分做最后冲刺。女单王祉怡对阵新加坡选手杨佳敏占据明显优势，有望晋级。整体来看，印尼公开赛作为超级1000赛事，是国羽检验训练成果的关键战，黄荻/刘阳等新组合也需通过高水平对抗积累经验。后续赛程中，年轻选手的发挥将直接影响巴黎奥运参赛资格竞争。
羽毛球.en:
The Indonesia Open badminton tournament is underway in Jakarta, with China's national team fielding strong lineups on Day 2. Key matches include Chen Boyang/Liu Yi against Indonesia's Alfian/Fikri, and Wang Zhiyi facing Singapore's Yeo Jia Min. Doubles pair Liang Weikeng/Wang Chang saw a ranking update, while Wang Chang reflects on lessons from recent performances.

- **Indonesia Open Day 2 schedule**: Chen Boyang/Liu Yi vs Alfian/Fikri (0-1 head-to-head); Wang Zhiyi vs Yeo Jia Min (6-0); Huang Di/Liu Yang vs Kevin Lee/Lindeman (unknown) ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5DaU1qRHQ5Yk1pVS1QNWdFa1BQM3NUdzA3cU5jX2hrMkhnd3FnYlpQNUlHc2VrRXNuUHB6OV9RZjJ1czAtT3ppdmFoLVNYVFlVNUdyQVZ0SGNoZXVuZjFIbUw4OA)).
- **National team daily schedule released**: Full day's program for Chinese shuttlers ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1scmhxMmlhb2xOYXdFUWIxM3BCV2RMZEF6cmJSZG9yTjV1RUpILWY4ZVlqcV9JYlZiTEZzWHJhYjJ1Vk1ITGc4bDJxWDVmVzRzR0FIRTZaTWM2Rm01em9NRDFWcw)).
- **Ranking update for Liang/Wang**: Doubles pair sees change in world rankings ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5JZVdfaFI3MGdUTGdKLVFVTThEVFBmci1hbDNtTzBKbkMxc3N2LXlScDF5WHZPVUN4Vktzcm40ZEhQb3N2N0JRby15VlNoQmY3YWZ4YmxhNzFOUklVNVB3MzdhRQ)).
- **Wang Chang reflects**: 'Lessons learned' from recent matches, aiming to improve ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1LRm1TMmU1QWJJSUJIYzhwTmFLQ0lzcTkwcnA1ZFItb1VNTlBBZG9UNHd4NkhJVlhsWnhsRGY0Zk53Yk5VMEh1ZHRoQlBkZHJSdDlFVzN6U29qWVZWUHc0bGpkUQ)).

The Indonesia Open results will be critical for seeding in upcoming major tournaments.

欧美.zh: 好莱坞陷入政治与内斗的双重震荡。真人秀明星斯宾塞·普拉特 (Spencer Pratt) 在洛杉矶市长初选中意外晋级决选，与现任市长凯伦·巴斯 (Karen Bass) 争夺宝座，消息由[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/spencer-pratt-karen-bass-l-a-mayor-election-results-runoff-1236939564/)和[Variety](https://variety.com/2026/politics/news/karen-bass-spencer-pratt-lead-l-a-mayor-primary-results-1236765425/)同时报道并相互印证。另一方面，60 Minutes老将斯科特·佩利 (Scott Pelley) 被CBS解雇后发表长篇声明，批评新管理层“无能且让新闻部陷入混乱”，[好莱坞报道](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/scott-pelley-cbs-news-firing-statement-bari-weiss-1236612393/)和Deadline均跟进。Netflix方面，《四季》与《好女孩谋杀指南》第二季收视大幅下滑，首季均曾登顶TOP10，第二季分别跌至第3和第9，暴露流媒体续集普遍疲软。罗伯特·帕丁森回应蝙蝠侠身材争议，称“每天健身”，为新片造势。泰勒·斯威夫特发文力挺保罗·麦卡特尼新专辑，引发粉丝联动效应。政治与娱乐的边界日益模糊，而传统新闻机构内部裂痕加深，值得持续关注。
欧美.en:
Hollywood is in shock as the L.A. mayoral primary produces a surreal runoff between incumbent Karen Bass and reality star Spencer Pratt. The result, which saw Pratt leading early returns, could reshape entertainment industry politics. Meanwhile, the CBS newsroom is reeling after veteran '60 Minutes' correspondent Scott Pelley was fired and unleashed a blistering public statement accusing management of bowing to Trump—a development that underscores the cultural rift at Paramount/Skydance. Elsewhere, Taylor Swift's shoutout to Paul McCartney’s new album and Robert Pattinson’s defiant response to Batman body criticism keep the celebrity machine humming.

- [It’s Bass Vs. Pratt: Early L.A. Mayor Election Results Leaning Towards Incumbent Against ‘Hills’ Villain In The Fall](https://deadline.com/2026/06/spencer-pratt-karen-bass-l-a-mayor-election-results-runoff-1236939564/) — Deadine
- [Fired Scott Pelley Slams CBS News: “Incompetence and Unprofessionalism In the New Management Have Wreaked Havoc”](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/scott-pelley-cbs-news-firing-statement-bari-weiss-1236612393/) — The Hollywood Reporter
- [Taylor Swift Shows Love for Paul McCartney’s New Album: ‘Never Not Inspired’](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/taylor-swift-paul-mccartney-the-boys-of-dungeon-lane-1235571508/) — Rolling Stone
- [Robert Pattinson Responds to Batman Body Backlash: “I Worked Out Every F***ing Day”](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/robert-pattinson-responds-batman-body-backlash-1236612171/) — The Hollywood Reporter
- [Netflix's 'The Four Seasons' & 'A Good Girl’s Guide To Murder' Suffer Sophomore Viewership Slump](https://deadline.com/2026/06/four-seasons-good-girls-guide-to-murder-s2-premiere-viewership-1236939594/) — Deadine

**Signal**: The convergence of entertainment figures into political candidacies is accelerating—watch for more celebrities to test the waters, especially if Pratt proves competitive in November.

日韩.zh: 韩剧与K-pop齐头并进。SBS公布下半年重磅剧集：李帝勋主演《The Long Shot Trial》扮演专接无胜算案件的古怪律所经理；朴敏英与陆星材搭档办公室爱情剧《Nine to Six》；苏志燮带着动作复仇剧《Agent Kim Reactivated》回归，首支预告已发布（以上信息均来自[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com)）。收视方面，《边缘医生》第二集升至5.0%，但《厨房士兵传说》仍稳居同时段冠军。音乐市场亮点：TREASURE迷你专辑《NEW WAV》首日销量59.2万张，刷新自身纪录；XLOV第二张迷你专辑首周销量环比翻近三倍；CORTIS的EP《GREENGREEN》连续三周位列Billboard 200第42名。新人偶像品牌声誉榜中，ILLIT的Wonhee蝉联第一。韩流在剧集和音乐两条线均保持高产，但同质化竞争也在加剧。
日韩.en:
K-drama and K-pop continue their global momentum with strong ratings and record-breaking sales. SBS unveiled an impressive slate of upcoming dramas, including 'The Long Shot Trial' starring Lee Je Hoon, 'Nine to Six' with Park Min Young and Yook Sungjae, and the action-packed 'Agent Kim Reactivated' featuring So Ji Sub. On the music side, TREASURE's 'NEW WAV' sold 592,158 copies on its first day, a personal best, while XLOV nearly tripled first-week sales with 'I,God'. CORTIS continues its Billboard 200 run at No. 42 for a third week, indicating sustained global interest in Korean acts. Meanwhile, 'Doctor on the Edge' ratings rose to 5.0%, and 'The Legend of Kitchen Soldier' remains the top-rated drama.

- [Lee Je Hoon Is An Eccentric Law Office Manager In New Drama “The Long Shot Trial”](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845426wpp/lee-je-hoon-is-an-eccentric-law-office-manager-who-only-takes-on-unwinnable-cases-in-new-drama-the-long-shot-trial) — Soompi
- [Park Min Young And Yook Sungjae Meet As Deputy Manager And Intern In “Nine to Six”](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845422wpp/park-min-young-and-yook-sungjae-meet-as-deputy-manager-and-intern-in-new-office-romance-drama) — Soompi
- [TREASURE Breaks 1st-Day Sales Record With “NEW WAV”](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845353wpp/treasure-breaks-their-1st-day-sales-record-tops-itunes-charts-worldwide-with-new-wav) — Soompi
- [CORTIS Spends 3rd Week on Billboard 200 With “GREENGREEN”](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845356wpp/cortis-breaks-personal-record-as-greengreen-spends-3rd-week-on-billboard-200) — Soompi
- [XLOV Nearly Triples 1st-Week Sales Record With “I,God”](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845350wpp/xlov-nearly-triples-their-1st-week-sales-record-with-igod) — Soompi

**Signal**: The SBS drama lineup suggests a strong second half of 2026—expect heated competition between 'Agent Kim Reactivated' and 'Doctor on the Edge' for viewership dominance.

中国.zh: 内地娱乐出现两大信号：一是现实主义电影《给阿嬷的情书》票房突破14亿，被媒体称为可能开启“中国影视文化战略转型”（[新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxNMjl5cjdFS0RHM1MyUTZhcFcwSzVQRl9mOW5HVGZqaHJvaFlLaDllQUxUREdoZF94THBGVE85VTM4d0VsUG5oS05iSVFTTjdGcF9fTDAxaUY2dzQyVDJIRXE2dWNpUjQ5NWVncVg3a04zdWZ2Q3pZeG9SQ1c1dHZjekN1TWNQRUE2NElN)），中国青年网也将其与《人世间》《山海情》并列为现实主义书写典范。二是周星驰宣布进军AI产业，网友戏称“娱乐圈黄仁勋”，但具体规划未明。戛纳中国之夜聚焦“科技+非遗+品牌”三维出海，中国AIGC影视成果首次国际发布。于正凌晨发文硬刚余华，直言戳破影视圈潜规则，引发业内站队。香港足球明星颁奖典礼中陈晋一当选最佳港队球员，但属体育娱乐交叉。现实主义小成本电影的崛起可能改变投资导向，而周星驰的跨界则需观望实际落地。
中国.en:
Chinese entertainment is riding a wave of cultural confidence and technological innovation. The box office success of '给阿嬷的情书' (A Letter to Grandma) with over ¥1.4 billion is being hailed as a turning point for domestic realist cinema, potentially reducing reliance on imported blockbusters. At the Cannes Film Festival, the 'China Night' event showcased AI-powered filmmaking tools, signaling Beijing's push to lead in AIGC (AI-generated content) for global audiences. Meanwhile, Stephen Chow's pivot to AI has sparked industry chatter, with netizens dubbing him the 'Jensen Huang of entertainment'. On a less uplifting note, producer Yu Zheng’s public spat with author Yu Hua has dominated social media, revealing the ongoing tension between commercial and literary instincts in Chinese film/TV.

- [票房破14亿，《给阿嬷的情书》或许是中国影视文化战略转型的开始](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxNMjl5cjdFS0RHM1MyUTZhcFcwSzVQRl9mOW5HVGZqaHJvaFlLaDllQUxUREdoZF94THBGVE85VTM4d0VsUG5oS05iSVFTTjdGcF9fTDAxaUY2dzQyVDJIRXE2dWNpUjQ5NWVncVg3a04zdWZ2Q3pZeG9SQ1c1dHZjekN1TWNQRUE2NElN)
- [戛纳中国之夜成文化出海新标杆：科技+非遗+品牌三维驱动](https://news.google.)
- [周星驰进军AI产业 网封“娱乐圈黄仁勋”](https://news.google.)
- [于正凌晨发长文硬刚余华](https://news.google.)

**Signal**: The intersection of AI and entertainment is becoming a state-backed priority—watch for more Chinese companies to announce AI film tools and for Stephen Chow to become a key figure in this space.

微博社区动态.zh: 微博热搜被几条娱乐瓜占据。李登科爆料王源“事业停滞”，引发粉丝热议（[新浪新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5HaVBhVDU4YkJjMTZNSXlWRkxqNkVIdFh4cXJmbE1XVFJNamxvTHVDMGNSYkxaQ2RLbF9zc2tRa0J1QWtteDVuejVybWYtXzF3Q2tpbjhOOGcxZWhRY293ejQtRQ)）。另一边，虞书欣新剧、陈都灵新剧《嘿热搜》以及“长月烬明冷落陈都灵”话题同时登榜，疑似粉丝营销联动。王一博与肖战各捐款50万元登上正能量热搜，但未注明具体事件。于正持续“毒舌”模式，被讨论是真实性情还是流量新招。此外，“神仙肉 陈星旭”话题秒上热搜，显示剧作预热阶段已有强粉丝基础。郑州鹦鹉热疫情也出现在娱乐版面，因登热搜而混入。总体看，明星个人动态主导话题，缺乏爆款作品讨论，粉丝控评痕迹明显。
微博社区动态.en:
Weibo's entertainment ecosystem is buzzing with fan wars, celebrity gossip, and industry scandals. The hottest trending topics include rumors that Wang Yuan's (王源) career has stalled, anticipation for Yu Shuxin's (虞书欣) new drama, and complaints that actor Chen Duling (陈都灵) was sidelined in the hit show '长月烬明'. Additionally, a joint charity donation of 500,000 yuan by Wang Yibo and Xiao Zhan (王一博肖战捐款50万) shows the enduring power of idol philanthropy. The biggest controversy, however, remains producer Yu Zheng's 'poison tongue' responses to critics, with netizens debating whether it's genuine personality or a calculated traffic strategy.

- [期待虞书欣新剧](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBNaGZrX2lKQnlYOWFHT1o3Rl9EaHpSc3pDWmFuczQwY0NyZWJIOFJsd1RONTJfUHJDRGVsNlM1RDM2bmRGZ3hSaERCc1ZfU056bDRDU3poZDA1aEw2SkZFYjNHZw)
- [长月烬明冷落陈都灵](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9hUThwekNjMjlxWDhXMHk3RjczaDhzVXQwTXlfalduQ0x0b05GWWdUVFRJQlltMV9ibmFxUEZiY2ZrWlBnRExVZXdsZHpDZ0hoUGc5U2xBWlZDOWk0T3pFWkxZOA)
- [王一博肖战捐款50万](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBwUXRGakZFSVFILUJfN3R6T3NEUG5wYldvNDNCQkdBdzlXaUZIZGRTSDVWbVNwcnNFTUktR0haaDF6Q21JZlk2NThsR3FTWlFOMDBHT3BMRXJEVG1rWnY1OFA2WQ)
- [于正开启“毒舌”回复模式，是真实性情还是流量新招？](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE0yM3F1N25uX2xfS1dabEdHVFUzN3dCWUlBS3d0a3R0UFdSdzZ1cWdjdXB0Q0o5RjNPUFhQMmEyR3dqcWlCNmFhb3h2SzRoOTlfM2JkS19hUDN1UkFXNHJlN3FrbjVlVXZfdG5WclQxejhMTUNMOW55TTM0czI)

**Signal**: The Yu Zheng controversy is likely to escalate—expect more industry insiders to weigh in, and watch for potential impact on upcoming drama projects he is involved with.
